what: cube cycles of MOXIR v5: the v4 scenes + the six cubes per scene at full power (level 1.0); 20
source: docs/moxir/scenes-v4-2026-10-18/scenes_v4.py from scripts/place/rigs/moxir-scenes-50-v2-2-2026-10-17.json (v2.2: palette, rules, the cube lasers' designs by colour)
licence: di.iiii project data (the owner's); MOXIR teaser frames used as reference only, never published

rules.floor: line L + line R lit in the scene's family colour like every wash (owner 12:0x); the v3 "floor never red" rule is withdrawn by that word
rules.flash: worst 1 s per lamp <= 3 flashes (WCAG 2.x flash definition, measured on fx.js)

eye_v3.no_saturated_blue_or_violet_lamps: linear B share >= 0.8 banned on every lamp (lasers excepted)
eye_v3.method: palette.py eye(); thresholds are taste, unvalidated

rules.beam_colours: v2.2: open, red-orange, lime only (owner 20:1x: lime, not regular colours)
rules.lasers: the laser session's current design (v5: whole field, levels 1.0) unchanged; updated later by the laser work, when ready
rules.wash_colours: v2.2: ember #ff3a12, lime #9cff00, white #ffffff only (lead 20:15); beams open #ffffff, red-orange #ff5a1e, lime #8cff3a only; no other colour
rules.family: one colour family per scene (+ white at <= 0.1 in a colour scene); red and green never together (R4, R5)
rules.holds: per scene, free (v4 does not follow the v6 laser frames' loop)
rules.laser40: the 40 W lines are a layer: laser40 per scene, laser_lines null unless --laser40 on (owner 12:0x: enough); graphics never 74,75,78,79,166,167,246-253
rules.levels: full power: every lit part 1.0 (owner 2026-10-18 00:2x "new 100 use full power")

colour_mix.method: share of lamp-level-seconds: level x number of lamps in the part (rig v2.10; outside re-parted as outside_rule.py) x (fade + hold), summed per colour over the 50 scenes

scenes_with_red_inside_per_act.rule: saturated red (WCAG 2.2 R share >= 0.8, linear) or hue within 15 deg of red at S >= 0.6, any inside part; the owner-set entrance is outside and not counted

scenes.title: Cloistral · Truss smoke
scenes.intent: The truss up into the haze, white; the 40 W draw white lines above the heads.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

scenes.notes: v4 scene 5; family white; full power: every lit part 1.0; lit 2

laser.why: v5: was single-scan — at every aim and cube group it broke a hall rule (lantern / entry wall / column line) without a waiver; now the net, which passes, in this scene's colour and tempo

refs: owner 17:5x: "look we dont need any dmx charts you fouund right" (N852)
laser40.why: the cubes scan one line each; the two 40 W lines close the X by up to 4° and open again, at the cubes' tempo; colour #ffffff = the unit's nearest diode colour to the scene laser #eefdfd (chart ch 5 makes 7 colours); base 0.6° up and 3° toward the centre line (ch 7 / ch 6 offsets; the units stay where the owner set them 02:18): the rigged aims cross the near crane (z 3.2) at 8.84 m < the 9.2 m rule, and line 42 crosses the east-west column line at 9.36 m < the 10.8 m truss bottom (laser_frames.py, 2026-10-15); with the base both clear (crane 9.38/9.40 m)
